title: Is it my laptop or Teams that keeps asking me
scenario: One user guesses at everything: it is only her, a cache clear may have helped, the message may have been a time-out, nobody changed a policy; the logs show that her sign-in was invalidated by a password change.

events.title: Teams keeps asking me to sign in
events.text: Hi, Teams keeps asking me to sign in since about yesterday afternoon. I think it is only me, my colleagues in the office do not have it, so it is not many people. Maybe it is the cache: I cleared it this morning and it seemed to help for a while, but I am not sure. The message might have been a time-out, I did not read it properly. I believe nobody changed any policy. Greta

events.title: Re: Teams keeps asking me to sign in
events.text: Hello Greta, thanks. Please send me your user name, the UTC moment of your last prompt, and whether it also happens in the browser version of Teams.

events.title: Re: Teams keeps asking me to sign in
events.text: My user name is g.bakker, the last prompt was today at 09:42 UTC. In the browser it also asks me, so it is not only the app.

events.title: Log search
events.text: Sign-in logs for g.bakker at 09:42 UTC: a failed row exists with error AADSTS50173. The stored grant is no longer valid, because the password of the user was changed or reset.

events.title: Re: Teams keeps asking me to sign in
events.text: Greta, thanks. Did you change or reset your password yesterday afternoon?

events.title: Re: Teams keeps asking me to sign in
events.text: Yes, I changed it yesterday at 13:30 UTC after the reminder. I did not sign in again on my phone though.

events.title: Re: Teams keeps asking me to sign in
events.text: That explains the prompts. Please sign out of Teams everywhere, phone included, then sign in once with the new password and tell me whether the prompts stop.

events.title: Re: Teams keeps asking me to sign in
events.text: I signed out everywhere and signed in again at 13:15 UTC. No prompt since.

events.title: Check after the sign-in
events.text: Check at 16:40 UTC: g.bakker has no failed rows since 13:15 UTC, and both the Teams app and the browser stay signed in.

events.title: Closing note
events.text: Greta, closing note: your sign-in was invalidated by the password change and the phone still held the old one. After a password change please sign in again on every device. I am closing the case.
